business_problem: ModMed needed to protect sensitive patient data and maintain compliance while reducing administrative overhead, improving access to operational data, and creating AI-enabled products and agentic workflows for ambulatory healthcare specialties.
solution_summary: ModMed uses the Databricks Data + AI Platform to support secure healthcare analytics and agentic workflows. The implementation pairs Lakebase with Unity Catalog so relational information can be queried in near real time while access stays governed through catalog structure, permissions, and context that fit healthcare security requirements. That governed data foundation helps ModMed move data where it is needed, speed up dashboards, and deliver actionable insights to care providers and internal teams. On top of the same environment, Genie Agents and Genie Code let non-technical teams interact with enterprise data through natural language instead of building separate custom AI applications for each request. The result is a single governed path from relational data access to dashboards and AI-enabled workflows that reduces administrative burden while supporting continued product innovation.
business_outcome: ModMed established a secure, governed foundation for AI-enabled products and agentic workflows, gave care providers and internal teams faster access to dashboards and actionable insights, and reduced administrative burden without compromising patient-data security or compliance.
architecture_clues: Lakebase provides near real-time querying of relational data.
Unity Catalog supplies catalog structure, user permissions, and context for governed access.
Genie Agents and Genie Code expose natural-language interaction with enterprise data.
Dashboards load rapidly to deliver immediate insights to care providers.
Cloud deployment is listed as AWS.
evidence_quotes: For ModMed, providing healthcare technology to ambulatory surgical specialties requires an infrastructure that upholds rigorous security while enabling continuous innovation.
To improve operational efficiency and data access, ModMed implemented Lakebase alongside Unity Catalog.
Together, they establish a foundation for high-performance agentic workflows.
Lakebase enables near real-time querying of relational data, allowing dashboards to load rapidly and deliver immediate insights to care providers.
Genie Agents and Genie Code understand catalog structure, user permissions and context, eliminating the need to build custom AI applications for every internal request.
